name: round_word
meaning: mov rsi,[r14+0x58]: current_round goes to the history window

name: tag_two
meaning: cmp qword [rsp+0x18],2: tag 2 is a delegate row

name: value_bit
meaning: test byte [rsp+0x40],1: value bit 0 skips the profile test

name: available
meaning: sub rax,rdi / cmovae rdx,rax: available is balance minus pending, floor 0

name: effective_min
meaning: cmovb rax,rbx: effective becomes min(effective, target)

name: tag_zero
meaning: cmp qword [rsp+0xf8],0: tag 0 alone runs the lock and floor tests

name: floor_compare
meaning: cmp rcx,[rsp+0xe0]: remainder against the value word

name: member_key_test
meaning: cmp r15,[r14+0x10]: e against the history key

name: member_min
meaning: cmovb rax,rbx: m becomes min(m, c)

name: time_add
meaning: call 0x1459ca0 through the slot: time plus seconds

name: member_snapshot
meaning: mov [rbx-8],r14: m takes c on the first change of an epoch

name: sink_stop
meaning: cmp al,2: kind 2 ends the row walk

name: range_upper
meaning: cmp rcx,[rsi+r11*8+8]: bound against keys, left edge means empty

name: set_size
meaning: cmp r14,4: boost needs four members

name: filter_live
meaning: mov byte [rax],1: a row with stake was taken
